Game Objective: Critical Vitality
Drinking Blood: Creating Nosferatu
Vampire Hunters
<Game Objective>
Drink human blood to build up the Vampir's
special source of power, "Critical Vitality,"
and defeat the vampire.
Build up the set value before the enemy does
to clear the stage.
<How to Increase Critical Vitality>
Drink a human's blood to create a servant,
a "Nosferatu."
When this happens, both the Nosferatu and the
player gain 1 point of Critical Vitality.
· Critical Vitality can be freely distributed
among your servant Nosferatu.
· A Nosferatu with no Critical Vitality
cannot act at night.
<Nosferatu and Critical Vitality>
Female - Production type
Doubles the Critical Vitality she holds in a night.
note: Female Nosferatu = production type, "she" is safe (type is defined by sex).

en: Male - Combat type
Takes Critical Vitality from enemy Dhampir.
· The Critical Vitality a single Nosferatu can
hold is limited.
A Nosferatu that holds a lot of
Critical Vitality will grow, and
become able to hold even more.
<Drinking Blood>
Visit a home at night to drink its residents' blood.
· The better you get along with a resident, the
more effectively they turn into a Nosferatu.
· When a resident has fully become a Nosferatu,

note: Whitespace-only indent for the name line (original is one full-width space).

en: 's stats rise.
· When the Blood Flow used for drinking blood
runs low, you can no longer drink blood.
Blood Flow has an upper limit, so the number of
times you can drink blood in a night is limited.
· "Stats" such as Blood Flow and Health
recover in the morning.
· Visit a resident's workplace every day
during the day to become friends with them.
· If the enemy is drinking the same person,
it can be hard to make them a Nosferatu.
<About Nosferatu>
Humans brought under your control by drinking
their blood are called "Nosferatu,"
and humans under an enemy vampire's control
are called "Dhampir."
<Direct and Subordinate Nosferatu>
Those you make by drinking yourself are "direct,"
and those a direct one creates are "subordinate."
